scope: finite 64-site computations only; no fractal scaling, spectral dimension, or physical interpretation claimed

filtration.definition: E_j = conditional expectation onto functions of the first j columns of Q6_states (columns 0..j-1); suffix columns j..5 averaged
filtration.preservation_criterion: a vertex map preserves E_j iff it maps the kept coordinate set {0,...,j-1} onto itself; coordinate bit flips commute with every E_j because flipping a kept coordinate relabels the prefix consistently on both sides of the commutator, while flipping an averaged coordinate permutes the fiber being summed

Q6_laplacian.provenance: data/RGS_PSU_all_matrices.npz::Q6_laplacian; verified identical to 6I - Q6_adjacency (standard unweighted hypercube Laplacian)
Q6_laplacian.role: control (research note Sec. 10 predicts zero commutator)

Q6_antipodal.provenance: data/RGS_PSU_all_matrices.npz::Q6_antipodal; symmetric involution, bitwise-complement permutation of the 64 states

Pi_AT.provenance: data/RGS_PSU_all_matrices.npz::Pi_AT; Anti-Twin involution on Q6 states (equivariance R_geo_tangent A = A Pi_AT, see scripts/audit_188d_antitwin.py)

P_antipodal_plus.role: derived sector projector (not a stored array)

P_antipodal_minus.role: derived sector projector (not a stored array)

P_AT_plus.role: derived sector projector (not a stored array)

P_AT_minus.role: derived sector projector (not a stored array)

synthetic_GOE_control.provenance: SYNTHETIC CONTROL: fixed-seed (20261124) GOE symmetric random matrix; not a stored Q6 operator, not a PRISM/Kathara candidate

reviewer_swap_cols_2_4_control.provenance: SYNTHETIC CONTROL: coordinate transposition (0-based cols 2<->4 = 1-based cols 3<->5); hypothesis control, NOT the stored Pi_AT (which decodes to a bit flip of columns 3,4,5)

missing_operators.coupled_or_weighted_vertex_operator: No weighted/coupled 64x64 vertex-space Q6 operator was found in data/RGS_PSU_all_matrices.npz or in the audited scripts. The stored Q6_laplacian is exactly the standard hypercube Laplacian, so its commutators vanish identically (control only). A genuine PRISM/Kathara coupled operator must be supplied with provenance before a nontrivial commutator test is possible.
